title: Paul McCartney live: Earls Court Exhibition Centre, London | 1993
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Earls Court Exhibition Centre in London, England, on 14 September 1993.

It was the 42nd night of the New World Tour, which lasted for 77 dates across 19 countries between February and December 1993, and the second of three non-consecutive nights at Earls Court.

McCartney’s band was Linda McCartney on vocals, keyboards, and percussion; Hamish Stuart on guitar, bass guitar, and vocals; Robbie McIntosh on guitar and vocals; Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens on keyboards and vocals; and Blair Cunningham on drums and percussion.

McCartney returned to Earls Court on 18, 19, 21, and 22 April 2003 for the Back In The World Tour, and 20 February 2008 for the Brit Awards.
